I'm an aspiring graphic designer with a Canva Design School certification and working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Adobe Express. My background as a data science student built a strong visual instinct — years of building dashboards and charts taught me how to turn dense, technical information into something a person can understand at a glance.

I'm especially drawn to healthcare communication design: patient-facing materials, awareness campaigns, and wellness branding. I bring detail-oriented, empathetic design thinking to every project, and I'm currently building a portfolio while open to freelance, internship, or entry-level design opportunities in a healthcare or hospital setting.
